title: Zero Dollars: 10 Things Locals Do for Free
description: A carefully verified shortlist of Karachi activities that require no admission or purchase, including public reading rooms and access available to specific age or student groups.

cards.title: Read and work free at Kitab Ghar
cards.subtitle: A citizen-funded public library with no entry or membership charge.
cards.notes: Kitab Ghar describes itself as an entirely free public library and also provides visitors with free Wi-Fi and mineral water. Check its current Karachi location before setting out.
cards.short_summary: Settle in with a book or a laptop at this entirely free, citizen-funded public library.

cards.title: Join the SBP Library free
cards.subtitle: Karachi residents outside the bank can apply for membership without a fee.
cards.notes: The library says outsiders—including students, academics, bankers, lawyers, businesspeople and journalists—may join, and membership is absolutely free. Applicants need the prescribed form, photographs, a CNIC copy and an in-service SBP employee as guarantor; original CNIC is required for entry.
cards.short_summary: Use a substantial institutional library without paying a membership charge, provided you complete its documentation requirements.
cards.source_title: FAQs — State Bank of Pakistan Library

cards.title: Tour the British Council library free
cards.subtitle: A pre-booked library tour costs nothing and does not require purchasing membership.
cards.notes: The British Council explicitly offers free tours of its Karachi library. This card covers the tour only: continued library access and borrowing require paid membership.
cards.short_summary: Book a no-cost look through the Clifton library before deciding whether membership suits you.

cards.title: See Mohatta Palace free if you’re under 12
cards.subtitle: Children younger than 12 receive free museum admission.
cards.notes: The museum’s official visitor information grants free admission to children under 12. Adults pay admission; the offer is therefore useful only to families visiting with eligible children.
cards.short_summary: Children under 12 can enter the museum galleries without an admission charge.
cards.source_title: About the Museum — Mohatta Palace Museum

cards.title: Enter free with a student study group
cards.subtitle: Organized student groups pay no museum admission when visiting for study and research.
cards.notes: The Government of Sindh’s museum page explicitly exempts student groups entering for study and research. General visitors pay the listed entrance fee, so arrange the group visit through an educational institution.
cards.short_summary: Students can examine the preserved house as a free group research visit.
cards.source_title: Quaid-e-Azam House Museum, Karachi — Directorate General of Antiquities, Government of Sindh

warnings: Only five activities met the requested evidence standard; the board is therefore incomplete rather than padded to ten.
Most supplied park candidates were excluded because their candidate records establish identity and location only, while accessible official or reliable sources did not explicitly confirm free entry.
The Mohatta Palace and Quaid-e-Azam House activities are eligibility-limited; their cards state the applicable age or student-group requirement.
No supplied candidate exactly matched a selected entity, so all place_id and maps_url fields are null.
